description: Answer "what did I miss?" in one read: the business's calls since a moment (default the last 24 hours, at most 30 days) with who called and what they wanted, every unheard voicemail with its transcript, texts that came in (needs sms:read), and open to-dos and callbacks. Read-only. Follow up with get_transcript, send_message to reply, or list_recent_calls / list_sms_messages to search further back.

since.description: ISO-8601 date or time to start from (optional, default 24 hours ago; clamped to the last 30 days).
